parameters.content:
## Daily Reels pipeline
Run config is the one place for settings: PUBLISH_DRY_RUN, COST_CAP_USD, MAX_REGENERATIONS, MAX_REEL_ATTEMPTS, the four poll caps, GRAPH_API_VERSION and SOURCE_INSTAGRAM_USERNAMES. Credentials are n8n credential refs, never raw keys. A capped loop that runs out ends in a Stop and Error node, which fires the error workflow.

### 1 · Ingest and dedupe
Dedupe check only reads. It skips posted and abandoned reels, and reels started MAX_REEL_ATTEMPTS times.

### 2 · Understand, write, cost cap
Cost cap check runs before every paid pass, including each regeneration. Over the cap, the run stops before any paid call.

### 3 · One scene at a time: still, then clip
Flux is submitted, polled until COMPLETED, and its image URL fetched before the image-to-video call. Both loops stop after a fixed number of polls.

### 4 · Collect clips, voice, render
Aggregate clips turns the per-scene items into one item. Redo clips skips the voice call and reuses the last voiceover.

### 5 · Ask the human
The buttons resume this execution: Approve, Rewrite script, Redo clips, and Reject. Rewrite script returns to lane 2, Redo clips to the cost cap check. Neither reruns the scrape. Reject, or a regeneration past the cap, logs the reel as abandoned. No tap in 24 hours ends the run.

### 6 · Publish, then log
Dry run? is the guard: unless PUBLISH_DRY_RUN is set to false, the run takes Mock publish and no Instagram, TikTok or YouTube node is called. Write dedupe log is the only write to the used-reel list and runs last. Workflow static data is saved only for active (non-manual) executions.
